parameters.name: HighRiskOperation
parameters.description:
The action to take on high-risk virus files. Valid values:
- **Quarantine**: quarantine quarantined file.
- **Notify**: report an alert only without taking action on quarantined file.

parameters.name: LowRiskOperation
parameters.description:
The action to take on low-risk virus files. Valid values:
- **Quarantine**: quarantine quarantined file.
- **Notify**: report an alert only without taking action on quarantined file.
- **None**: take no action.

parameters.name: MatchMode
parameters.description:
The matching method for the effective scope. Valid values:
- **UserGroupAll**: the policy takes effect for all users under the current Alibaba Cloud account.
- **UserGroupNormal**: the policy takes effect only for users in specified user groups. UserGroupIds is required when this value is specified.

parameters.name: MaxCpuUsage
parameters.description: The maximum percentage of terminal CPU usage during scanning. Valid values: 0 to 100. If this parameter is not specified or is set to 0, the default value based on PerformanceMode is used: 50 for SecurityFirst, 30 for Balance, and 15 for ExperienceFirst.

parameters.name: MidRiskOperation
parameters.description:
The action to take on medium-risk virus files. Valid values:
- **Quarantine**: quarantine quarantined file.
- **Notify**: report an alert only without taking action on quarantined file.

parameters.name: PerformanceMode
parameters.description:
The scan performance mode. Valid values:
- **SecurityFirst**: security first. The default CPU usage limit is 50%.
- **Balance**: balanced. The default CPU usage limit is 30%.
- **ExperienceFirst**: experience first. The default CPU usage limit is 15%.

parameters.name: Priority
parameters.description: The policy priority. A smaller value indicates a higher priority. Valid values: 1 to 100.

parameters.name: ScanBeginTime
parameters.description: The start hour for triggering scans, specified as a whole hour. Valid values: 0 to 23 (inclusive). This field is not a timestamp.

parameters.name: ScanEndTime
parameters.description: The end hour for triggering scans, specified as a whole hour. Valid values: 1 to 24 (exclusive of the specified hour). The value must be greater than ScanBeginTime. Scan tasks generated by each trigger expire at this hour on the same day. This field is not a timestamp.

parameters.name: ScanFrequency
parameters.description:
The unit of the trigger cycle. Valid values:
- **day**: by day.
- **week**: by week.

parameters.name: ScanInterval
parameters.description: The interval number of the trigger cycle. This parameter works together with ScanFrequency to determine the trigger cycle. Valid values: 1 to 30. For example, if ScanFrequency is set to week and ScanInterval is set to 1, the scan is triggered once a week.

parameters.name: ScanMode
parameters.description:
The path scope of the scan. Valid values:
- **Quick**: quick scan. Only system critical directories and common risk locations are scanned.
- **Full**: full disk scan.
- **Custom**: custom path scan. ScanPath is required when this value is specified.

parameters.name: ScanPath
parameters.description: The collection of custom scan paths. This parameter is required when ScanMode is set to Custom and cannot be specified when ScanMode is set to Quick or Full. A maximum of 100 paths can be specified. Duplicate values are not allowed.

parameters.name: ScanTargets
parameters.description: The collection of virus types to be handled in this scan. At least one type must be specified. Duplicate values are not allowed.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The enabling status. Valid values:
- **Enabled**: Enabled.
- **Disabled**: Disabled.

After the policy is enabled, it immediately participates in periodic scheduling. When the policy is disabled, it is only saved and does not trigger scans.

parameters.name: StrategyDescription
parameters.description: The policy description. The description can contain Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, spaces, periods (.), commas (,), semicolons (;), forward slashes (/), at signs (@), hyphens (-), and underscores (_).

parameters.name: StrategyName
parameters.description: The policy name. The name can contain Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). Spaces are not supported.

parameters.name: UserGroupIds
parameters.description: The collection of user group IDs for the effective scope. This parameter is required when MatchMode is set to UserGroupNormal and cannot be specified when MatchMode is set to UserGroupAll. At least 1 and at most 100 IDs can be specified. Duplicate values are not allowed.

parameters.name: Whitelist
parameters.description: The list of exempt users. Users in this list are excluded from the scan triggered by this policy. A maximum of 1000 users can be specified. Duplicate values are not allowed.
